data.title: Man’s Manslaughter Sentence Tossed Out After Court Determines AI Video of Victim Speaking Beyond the Grave Crossed the Line
data.description: An Arizona appeals court vacated Gabriel Paul Horcasitas’ manslaughter sentence after ruling that an AI victim impact video violated fair sentencing protections. Horcasitas was convicted in the 2021 shooting death of Christopher Pelkey in 2025.
